senses.sense_definition: An obsession with grandiose or extravagant things, or an exaggerated belief in one's own importance and power.

examples.text: The dictator's <w>megalomania</w> led him to construct enormous monuments dedicated to himself throughout the capital.
Critics accused the director of sheer <w>megalomania</w> after he demanded an unlimited budget for his film.

senses.sense_definition: A psychological condition characterized by delusional fantasies of wealth, power, genius, or omnipotence.

examples.text: The patient showed severe symptoms of <w>megalomania</w>, genuinely believing he was the ruler of a secret empire.
Clinicians observed that his paranoia was accompanied by acute <w>megalomania</w> and grand illusions.

senses.sense_definition: An informal or obsolete term for narcissistic personality disorder.

examples.text: Early twentieth-century psychologists frequently diagnosed cases of extreme narcissism under the diagnostic label of <w>megalomania</w>.
Modern psychiatry has largely replaced the diagnostic category of <w>megalomania</w> with narcissistic personality disorder.

traits.comment: superseded by narcissistic personality disorder in formal psychiatry
